feed_summary: View CSAF Summary Mendix SAML module contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to gain unauthorized access by replaying a valid SAML assertion in IdP-initiated authentication flows. Siemens has released new versions for the affected products and recommends to update to the latest versions. The following versions of Siemens Mendix SAML Module are affected: Mendix SAML (Mendix 10 compatible) vers:intdot/<4.2.4 (CVE-2026-89209) Mendix SAML (Mendix 11 compatible) vers:intdot/<4.2.4 (CVE-2026-89209) Mendix SAML (Mendix 9 compatible) vers:intdot/<3.6.29 (CVE-2026-89209) CVSS Vendor Equipment v3 6.8 Siemens Mendix SAML (Mendix 10 compatible) 1 Vulnerability Authentication Bypass by Capture-replay Background Critical Infrastructure Sectors:
title: Siemens Mendix SAML Module
